who: Real stack · local stand-ins for the HR system, Google Workspace, Slack and GitHub
title: Access that follows the HR record: joiners, movers, leavers
sub: Google Workspace, Slack and GitHub kept in line with the HR system, privileged access approved by managers, drift found, every change audited.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Google Admin SDK · Slack SCIM · GitHub API · signed webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: Everyone's access comes from the HR system: Google, Slack, and GitHub for engineers
HR hires Mira for Engineering, starting today. Her accounts and groups appear on their own
Jonas needs GitHub admin rights. IT can ask, but only his manager can approve
Hanna gets the request as a Slack message with a signed link, and approves
Then Jonas leaves, effective immediately. Every account, group and admin right goes within seconds
His Drive goes to his manager, and his open sessions are ended
Drift: someone added a contractor as admin by hand, and a stray Slack account exists
Found, and removed with one click each. All of it lands in the audit trail
